description: Construction of a new, $260 million Moccasin Bend Mental Health Institute is planned for a site 4 miles southwest of its present location, on an almost 50-acre site between Chattanooga's Lookout Valley community and the Georgia state line. title: Chattanooga site named for new Moccasin Bend mental hospital — Senator Bo Watson
